Learn moreSign in Comments 4 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Description Apollo 11: The Mission that Took Us to the Moon #moonlanding #NASA #moonwalk 62Likes6,291ViewsJan 292026 We're heading back to the Moon! As we gear up for the Artemis II launch, let's remember the historic flight that started it all. On July 20, 1969, humanity achieved the unthinkable: landing on the Moon. Apollo 11, NASA’s landmark mission, saw astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walk on the lunar surface, while Michael Collins orbited above in the Command Module. Star Gazers host Trace Dominguez explores this historic journey, from liftoff to splashdown, and reflects on how it changed our view of the universe forever. #apollo11 #moon #buzzaldrin #neilarmstrong #apollomission #spacefacts #spacetravel #SpaceExploration #artemismission #artemislaunch …...more ...more Show less How this was madeAuto-dubbedAudio tracks for some languages were automatically generated.
